metadata.title: Credits — NebulaCoop
metadata.description: The projects and people behind NebulaCoop, starting with Nebula by keepvaibin.

footer.paragraph_1: Co-op by @Mackery6969, built on Nebula by @keepvaibin
footer.paragraph_2: © 2026 Mackery and keepvaibin. NebulaCoop, like Nebula, is free software under the GNU GPL v3. Super Mario Galaxy, Wii and Nintendo are trademarks of Nintendo. NebulaCoop is not affiliated with Nintendo.

page.paragraph_2: The projects and people behind NebulaCoop.

nebula.p_1: NebulaCoop is a fork of Nebula, the native PC port of Super Mario Galaxy, by keepvaibin. Everything that makes the game run on a PC is Nebula’s: the host, the renderers, Setup and the launcher, controller and Wii Remote support, mods, LumaScript and LumaLink, achievements and the settings menu. NebulaCoop follows Nebula closely and brings in its changes regularly.
nebula.p_2: This website is a remix of Nebula’s own website, with its design, its home page scene and its modding documentation.

coop.p_1: sm64coopdx and its CoopNet are the model for how co-op plays here: rooms and room codes, instances, player interaction, the bubble on death, chat commands, pop-ups, characters, palettes and the Personal Star Counter. Its design is followed; its code is not used.
coop.p_2: NebulaCoop’s co-op is made by Mackery. NebulaNet, its room-code service, and LumaLink Coop are NebulaCoop projects too.

game.p_1: Super Mario Galaxy is a Nintendo game. Its worlds, characters, music and story come from your own copy. NebulaCoop and Nebula are not affiliated with Nintendo.

petari.p_1: Nebula is built from Petari, SMGCommunity’s decompilation of Super Mario Galaxy, licensed under CC0 1.0.

thanks.p_1: Aurora, Dusklight, SMAA, AMD FidelityFX, Snapdragon Game Super Resolution, NVIDIA Streamline, SDL, dav1d, nod and others. The third-party notices list each component and its license.
